T:P1.4.text: World Leader In Industrial Process Heating

T:P1.6.text: Learn from Thermon engineers and product experts. Explore live sessions, visit us at industry events, or watch on-demand.

T:P1.7.text: From electric heat tracing to explosion-proof heaters, Thermon delivers engineered thermal solutions across every industry and environment.

T:P1.8.text: Electric heat, immersion, circulation, and specialty heaters for every industrial application.

T:P1.9.text: Electrical heat tracing cables, steam trace products, controls, and monitoring systems.

T:P1.10.text: Explosion-proof and rugged heating solutions engineered for the harshest transportation environments.

T:P1.11.text: General purpose and hazardous location power distribution panels and accessories for project sites.

T:P1.12.text: Electrically heated, steam, and pre-insulated tubing bundles with complete system accessories.

T:P1.13.text: Precision thermal management solutions designed to protect critical data center infrastructure.

T:P1.14.text: Heated flat blankets and container temperature control for custom industrial heating needs.

T:P1.15.text: Steam, hot water, and electrode boilers plus ancillary equipment for precision thermal processes.

T:P1.16.text: High-performance steam, hot oil, and hot water boilers with superheaters and ancillary systems.

T:P1.17.text: Our customers rely on us to provide high quality, safe, reliable and environmentally responsible solutions for their heating needs.

T:P1.18.text: Whether you’re looking for complete flow assurance, industrial heating, temperature maintenance, freeze protection or environmental monitoring, Thermon has you covered.

T:P1.19.text: We proudly celebrate our 70th anniversary! Since our founding in by Richard Burdick, Thermon has been dedicated to innovation in heat transfer solutions.

T:P1.20.text: From introducing heat transfer cement to pioneering the first packaged tracing systems and developing high-performance heating technologies, we’ve consistently pushed the boundaries to meet our customers’ needs

C:P1.1.text: SPX Technologies - Home - SPX Technologies in Charlotte, NC

C:P1.2.text: SPX Technologies is a supplier of highly engineered products and technologies, holding leadership positions in the HVAC and detection and measurement markets.

C:P1.3.text: Our segment offers a market leading portfolio of trusted niche brands that set the standard for how HVAC systems are designed, selected, and evolved — delivering purpose-built, sustainable solutions for Engineers, Owners, and Contractors across critical environments.

C:P1.4.text: SPX Engineered Air Movement Cincinnati Fans, Daniels Fans, Strobic Air, Tamco Industrial fans, blowers, critical exhaust systems and dampers

C:P1.5.text: Ingénia Technologies Custom air handling solutions for critical applications

C:P1.6.text: SPX Cooling Tech Marley, Recold, SGS Cooling towers, fluid coolers, evaporative condensers, adiabatic cooling systems and dry coolers

C:P1.7.text: ASPEQ Heating Group Accutherm, Banner Day, BBC, Brasch, Heatrex, Indeeco, Solar Products, Spectrum Industrial, commercial and military electric heaters

C:P1.8.text: Marley Engineered Products Commercial and residential supplemental electric heat

C:P1.9.text: Neptronic Controls, actuated valves, electric heaters and integrated HVAC technologies

C:P1.11.text: Patterson-Kelley Commercial boilers, water heaters, heat pumps and control systems

C:P1.12.text: Sigma and Omega Hydronic heating, vertical stack heating & cooling, and commercial indoor DX cooling equipment.

C:P1.13.text: Weil-McLain® Boilers, heat pump systems and indirect-fired water heaters

C:P1.14.text: Williamson-Thermoflo® Residential and light commercial boilers, furnaces and water heaters

C:P1.15.text: Our Detection & Measurement segment provides specialized underground location and inspection equipment, fare collection systems, aids to navigation, and communication technologies products.

C:P1.16.text: SPX AtoN (Aids to Navigation) Flash, ITL, Avlite, Sabik, Sealite Marine Lighting, Buoys, Port Entry Solutions and Lighthouse Systems

C:P1.18.text: CUES Water, wastewater and stormwater inspection equipment

C:P1.20.text: TCI RF communication technologies, spectrum monitoring and signals intelligence systems

C:P1.23.text: Genfare Mobile ticketing and fare collection technologies

C:P1.26.text: The IoT-enabled Vendstar® ticket vending machine (TVM) makes it easy for riders to purchase or add value to smart fare media at an unmanned kiosk, 24/7.

C:P1.27.text: The addition of Crawford United’s commercial air-handling equipment segment will expand SPX Technologies’ HVAC capabilities with highly engineered custom air-handling solutions.

C:P1.28.text: Marley OlympusMAX: The Peak of Fluid Cooler Performance

C:P1.29.text: Transform heat rejection with a flexible fluid cooler design that optimizes water and energy use. The OlympusMAX is built for simplified installation, reliable uptime, and scalable performance.

C:P1.30.text: The addition of Thermolec’s custom electric duct heating and related solutions serves as a natural extension of SPX’s Electric Heat strategy.
